subject: Recap: Lucent Health pilot — token profile, target $/1M & next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@lucenthealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Lucent Health pilot — token profile, target $/1M & next steps

Thanks for the time today, Claire — great conversation. Below is a short written recap and the concrete next steps so we can align on budget and procurement. I attached a quick cost calculator and a one-page invoice preview for your finance team (filenames below).

Quick summary of the call
- Use case: clinical intake summarization + triage routing for telehealth intake forms (mix of short and long inputs).
- Target latency: P95 <= 600ms for short queries; batch windows for nightly bulk transforms acceptable.
- Expected traffic profile (you mentioned rough numbers during the call):
  • Low: 5M tokens/mo (pilot minimal)
  • Mid: 30M tokens/mo (most likely per your cadence)
  • High (spike days / seasonal): 120M tokens/mo

Unit economics & target $/1M tokens
- Baseline (raw hosted inference, no caching): ~ $1,200 per 1M tokens for the model family we discussed (redwood-compact-8B-q4 equivalent).
- Typical effective price after cache/prefix reuse and batching: 30-40% lower depending on hit rate.
- For planning purposes we modeled three pilots with target effective ranges:
  • Pilot A (5M/mo): $1,000–$1,400 per 1M tokens (pilot tooling + small-scale ops overhead)
  • Pilot B (30M/mo): $520–$760 per 1M tokens (with caching + burst management)
  • Pilot C (100M+/mo): $360–$520 per 1M tokens (discounts for committed capacity + autoscale optimization)

What I attached for your review
- lucent_pilot_cost_calc_v1.xlsx — interactive calculator: line-item compute, storage, caching savings, and discount slider for 3/6/12 month commits.
- lucent_pilot_invoice_preview.csv — one-page mock invoice showing monthly line items for Pilot B (30M tokens).
- lucent_pilot_burn_curve.png — visual burn profile used to model spikes.

Open questions / asks from you
1) Can you confirm the budget band you’re comfortable with for a 30–60 day pilot (range is fine)? We modeled $15k–$55k/month as realistic depending on cache hit rates.
2) Who on your procurement/finance should I loop in (email preferred) for a formal invoice and net terms discussion?
3) Any regulatory constraints around logging/retention we should model for additional storage costs?

Next steps
- I’ll iterate the calculator to include the spike day profile you mentioned (30M baseline with occasional 4x days) and send an updated invoice preview by EOD Monday.
- If budget aligns, we’ll propose a 30–60 day pilot (can include a 6-week reserved commit for a nominal discount).

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call to walk the calculator with your finance team.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[aisha.rahman@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments referenced: lucent_pilot_cost_calc_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), lucent_pilot_invoice_preview.csv (CSV), lucent_pilot_burn_curve.png (image)
From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@lucenthealth.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Lucent Health pilot — token profile, target $/1M & next steps

Thanks, Aisha — helpful summary. A few quick notes:
- We expect closer to ~30M tokens/month in steady state, with spikes up to ~110–130M on peak days. The mid scenario is the right baseline.
- Procurement: I’ve looped in procurement@lucenthealth.ai for timeline — we usually need a 30-day review for standard SOWs.
- Can you produce a single-line monthly invoice mock showing the all-in monthly charge (so finance can see a top-line number before we dig into details)?

I’ll confirm the internal budget band by early next week, but FYI leadership is comfortable exploring the mid-pilot range.

— Claire
Director, Product Ops | Lucent Health
claire.zhao@lucenthealth.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Lucent pilot calc notes (internal)

Looping in a couple of quick items before Aisha pushes the updated invoice:
- Add an APAC fallback cost column for resilience; Lucent has partners there and we should show additional egress/replicate costs.
- Include a committed-usage discount tier in the calculator: 6mo 10%, 12mo 18% (applied to compute line only).
- Add a separate line for retained logs storage (30/90/365 day retention choices) — finance will ask.
- For the single-line invoice ask, prepare both: (A) list price monthly (no discounts) and (B) effective monthly after cache savings + conservative 15% efficiency.

I sketched a suggested target: for 30M tokens, effective target $/1M = $420 (this assumes ~35% cache hit and batching improvements). If procurement asks for lower, we can show a path to $360 with a 6–12 month commit.

Marcus
Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@lucenthealth.ai>, procurement@lucenthealth.ai
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Updated: Invoice preview + calculator (incl. spikes & commitments)

Hi Claire / procurement team — attached are the updates we discussed. Highlights below and a clear next-step checklist.

Highlights (updated models attached)
- Single-line mock monthly invoice: $15,600 (list price, no discounts) and $12,960 (projected effective monthly after conservative 17% cache + batching uplift). This maps to an effective $/1M tokens of $520 (list) and $432 (projected) for a 30M token baseline.
- If Lucent commits to a 6-month reserved commit (minimum 50% of baseline), we can present a 10% compute discount bringing the projected effective $/1M to ~$390.
- We added APAC fallback cost column and a separate storage/retention section (see tabs in spreadsheet).

Files attached
- lucent_pilot_cost_calc_v1.xlsx — updated with: spike-day model, discount slider, region fallback column, storage retention toggles.
- lucent_pilot_invoice_preview.csv — now contains two rows (list price monthly, projected effective monthly).
- lucent_pilot_burn_curve.png — updated burn visualization (peak day baked in).

Links
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7421
- Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-lucent-pilot
- DocuSign (if we proceed): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/packet/DEAL-8421

Next steps (please confirm)
1) Claire / procurement: confirm the budget band for the pilot (top-line monthly number or range). If you can provide a quick “OK to proceed to invoice” we’ll generate a formal SOW and DocuSign package.
2) If budget looks good, Marcus / Dylan and I can run a 30-minute walkthrough of the calculator with your finance team (I recommend including procurement + engineering for the spike profile).
3) We’ll turn the calculator into a pro forma invoice (net-30 terms by default) and send for signature.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call Monday afternoon PT if that works.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: lucent_pilot_cost_calc_v1.xlsx, lucent_pilot_invoice_preview.csv, lucent_pilot_burn_curve.png
